name: Auto Buffer
description: Automatically buffs levels by adjusting scale, tightness, and hazards on load!

scale-hazards.name: Scale Spikes & Hazards
scale-hazards.description: Increases the scale of spikes and hazards to tighten jump timings.

hazard-scale-factor.name: Hazard Scale Multiplier
hazard-scale-factor.description: How much larger to make spikes and obstacles (e.g., 1.25 = 25% bigger).

tighten-portals.name: Tighten Speed/Size Portals
tighten-portals.description: Slightly reduces portal scale to demand tighter entrances.
